name: ISS $OEM Source Node
description: Single-source flow node (SDN OD-Flow Phase 1b): on a timer 'tick' it emits the ISS operator ephemeris as an SDS $OEM FlatBuffer (aligned-binary, typed $OEM) on the 'oem' output port. The $OEM is built in-module from the checked-in NASA ISS OEM fixture (EME2000, TIME_SYSTEM UTC, CENTER Earth) via the inverse of analysis/od's oem_fb_reader — the SAME state series the sacred RMS-parity gate uses. It STORES NOTHING: ephemeris exists only as the emitted frame, held in memory for the duration of the OD fit downstream. This ISS slice is the vertical-slice source; the real per-provider fetch chain (ephem-request/http/oem-parse) is a later increment. No capabilities.

inputPorts.description: Cron timer tick that drives one $OEM emission.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM ephemeris (FlatBuffer or aligned-binary). Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.

methods.description: Builds the ISS $OEM FlatBuffer from the embedded fixture and emits it on a timer tick.

inputPorts.description: Cron timer tick that drives one compact $OEM emission.

acceptedTypeSets.description: SDS $OEM ephemeris (compact form: EPHEMERIS_DATA + START_TIME + STEP_SIZE). Consumed in-memory by analysis/od.fit; never stored.

methods.description: Builds the ISS $OEM in the COMPACT form (flat EPHEMERIS_DATA + START_TIME + STEP_SIZE) that uniform-cadence providers carry, and emits it on a timer tick.
